name: Major cyber incidents
summary: CISA added exploited VMware vCenter, SAP and Cisco flaws on 20 Nov; no national-scale attack found
state: CISA added four actively exploited vulnerabilities on 20 Nov, in Broadcom VMware vCenter, SAP NetWeaver, Cisco Expressway and Apache Roller, after Synology DSM and LiteLLM on 18 Nov (CISA). US officials said a wave of outages on 12–17 Nov showed no sign of a cyberattack (Fortune). Exploitation of widely used enterprise products keeps Watch; no national-scale attack was found.
for_you: Organisations running the affected products should follow CISA and NCSC guidance on patching. Individuals should keep devices updated.
rubric_hit: Exploited flaws in widely used enterprise products = Watch

sources.title: Fortune — Downdetector logged 6.4 million US outage reports in a week

why: Ransomware and state hacking now shut down hospitals, retailers, carmakers and airports for weeks.
drivers: Ransomware gangs, state actors, zero-days, supply-chain compromises.

rubric.alert: National-scale attack on critical infrastructure (power, health, finance), or a destructive state-attributed attack.
rubric.watch: Ransomware or attack disrupting a large company or critical service, or a mass-exploited zero-day.
rubric.normal: No major incidents disrupting critical services this week.
